blocks.en: Gas cloud harvesting is the process of collecting gas from interstellar clouds, for use in combat booster, Tech III and capital ship production.
blocks.zh: 气云采集是从星际云团中收集气体的过程，所得气体用于生产战斗增效剂、T3 和旗舰。

blocks.en: Players harvesting (or "huffing") gas locate a "nebula" in known space or a "fullerite reservoir" in wormhole space, and collect it with a gas cloud harvester module. Note that although the in-game probing window classifies "chemical labs" as a type of gas site, they are actually combat-and-hacking locations, and should be avoided by gas harvesting ships.
blocks.zh: 采集气云（俗称“吸气”）的玩家会在已知空间寻找“星云”，或在虫洞空间寻找“富勒体储藏库”，然后用气云采集装备收集气体。注意，虽然游戏内的探针窗口把“化学实验室”归为气云站点的一种，但它们实际上是战斗加破解站点，气云采集船应当避开。

blocks.en: Note that the new mining critical hit mechanic from the Catalyst expansions does NOT apply to gas harvesting.
blocks.zh: 注意，催化剂资料片新增的采矿暴击机制并不适用于气云采集。

blocks.en: Types of gas
blocks.zh: 气云种类

blocks.en: The three types of gas are all found in cosmic signatures which need to be probe scanned down in order to harvest.
blocks.zh: 三种气云都位于需要用探针扫描才能找到的宇宙信号中，扫出来后才能采集。

blocks.en: Most Nebula sites will display the following pop-up message when warped to. This can be useful to determine if a bookmark is still connected to an active site or if it has despawned. The message's title will be the name of the type of gas within the site.
blocks.zh: 跃迁到大多数星云站点时，会弹出下面这条消息。可以借此判断某个书签是否仍对应着一个有效的站点，还是站点已经消失。消息的标题就是站点中气云的种类名称。

blocks.en: Pop-up message — (Type of gas in site)
blocks.zh: 弹出消息——（站点中的气云种类）

blocks.en: Originally thought to be little more than a picturesque deviation from the monotonous emptiness of space, scientists and unscrupulous entrepreneurs alike have begun to appreciate the various gas cloud formations that have been discovered in recent years. Initial research into the properties of the gaseous phenomena revealed that when it came to facilitating the growth of certain types of crystal, they were one of the most conducive environments in the entire cluster. At first the crystal byproducts were viewed as a potential military innovation, offering slightly improved cost efficiency in electronics and weapons manufacture. When their massive potential for use in booster production was discovered however, viewpoints shifted dramatically, and nowadays they are coveted as a fundamental resource driving the burgeoning booster industry.
blocks.zh: 起初，人们认为这些气云不过是单调空旷的太空中一处风景如画的点缀，但近年来，科学家和不择手段的企业家们都开始重视这些新发现的各种气云形态。对这类气态现象性质的初步研究表明，在促进某些晶体生长方面，它们是整个星团中最有利的环境之一。最初，这些晶体副产品被视为一项潜在的军事革新，可以略微提高电子设备和武器制造的成本效益。然而，当人们发现它们在增效剂生产中的巨大潜力后，看法发生了巨大转变，如今它们已成为推动蓬勃发展的增效剂产业的基础资源，备受追捧。

blocks.en: Mykoserocin
blocks.zh: 磷胶溶质（Mykoserocin）

blocks.en: Mykoserocin is used to produce synth variation of combat boosters, and neurolink enhancers, which are part of all capital ship production chains. Nebulae with Mykoserocin can be found in high, low and null security space. All of them reside in non-deadspace areas and are not guarded by NPCs.
blocks.zh: 磷胶溶质用于生产合成型战斗增效剂，以及神经链接增强器，后者是所有旗舰生产链的组成部分。含有磷胶溶质的星云在高安、低安和 00 区都能找到。它们都位于非死亡空间区域，也没有 NPC 守卫。

blocks.en: Please note that list of locations where each Nebula site spawns is not exhaustive. It was expanded and new data is still being added.
blocks.zh: 请注意，各星云站点的刷新位置列表并不完整。列表已经扩充过，新数据仍在陆续补充中。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: Mykoserocin used to spawn similarly to Cytoserocin, highly concentrated in a specific constellation of a specific region. This was changed on 13 April 2014, when its spawn locations were significantly extended to accommodate increased demand. List of old spawn locations is below: Now, these areas don't seem to be special when it comes to gas harvesting. But, each constellation always has a synth booster laboratory, a hacking site which drops synth reactions, among other things.
blocks.zh: 磷胶溶质过去的刷新方式与丝胶溶质类似，高度集中在特定星域的特定星座中。2014 年 4 月 13 日对此做了修改，大幅扩展了刷新位置，以满足不断增长的需求。旧的刷新位置列表如下：如今，这些区域在气云采集方面似乎并没有什么特别之处。不过，每个星座都有一个合成增效剂实验室，这是一种破解站点，会掉落合成反应配方等物品。

blocks.en: Cytoserocin
blocks.zh: 丝胶溶质（Cytoserocin）

blocks.en: Cytoserocin is used to produce stronger variations of combat boosters. It is used in neurolink enhancers' production just like Mykoserocin, but amounts needed for that are much more modest. Unlike most exploration sites, nebulae are not randomly distributed throughout space. Each flavor of gas will be concentrated in one constellation of one region, and some regions will never have a cytoserocin nebula appear.
blocks.zh: 丝胶溶质用于生产更强版本的战斗增效剂。它和磷胶溶质一样也用于生产神经链接增强器，但所需数量要少得多。与大多数探索站点不同，这些星云并不是在太空中随机分布的。每种气云会集中在某个星域的某个星座中，有些星域永远不会出现丝胶溶质星云。

blocks.en: Majority of Cytoserocin nebulae are unstable. Every time a Gas Cloud Harvester finishes its cycle there is a chance that the cloud will "explode", dealing some damage to your ship. For exact numbers and damage types refer to the table below. There, each row represents an individual possibility. Bear in mind that damage area seems to be defined separately from gas cloud area. Depending on nebula type, damage area center might not coincide with the gas cloud center, and damage radius might be bigger or smaller than the cloud's radius as well.
blocks.zh: 大多数丝胶溶质星云都不稳定。每当气云采集器完成一个周期，云团都有一定几率“爆炸”，对你的船造成一些伤害。具体数值和伤害类型请参阅下表，表中每一行代表一种独立的可能。注意，伤害区域似乎是独立于气云区域单独定义的。根据星云类型的不同，伤害区域的中心可能与气云中心不重合，伤害半径也可能比云团半径更大或更小。

zh: 无伤害 1000 电磁 + 1000 热能

blocks.en: Fullerenes
blocks.zh: 富勒烯（Fullerenes）

blocks.en: Main article: Wormhole gas sites
blocks.zh: 主条目：虫洞气云站点

blocks.en: Fullerenes are used in Tech 3 and Capital production, and can only be found at sites in wormhole space. It comes in several different flavors of varying value. Fullerite gas sites spawn in all classes of wormhole, but the valuable Instrumental Core Reservoir and Vital Core Reservoir will only spawn in C5 and C6 wormholes, or shattered wormholes of any class.
blocks.zh: 富勒烯用于 T3 和旗舰生产，只能在虫洞空间的站点中找到。它有好几个种类，价值各不相同。富勒体气云站点在所有等级的虫洞中都会刷新，但值钱的关键核心储藏库和要害核心储藏库只在 C5 和 C6 虫洞，或任意等级的破碎虫洞中刷新。

blocks.en: Fullerene sites are undefended when first warped to, but will spawn several Sleeper NPCs after a certain amount of time has passed (usually about 15-20 minutes). Thus, it is possible to "ninja harvest" wormhole gas sites by harvesting gas until the Sleepers arrive, and then warping away before they can attack.
blocks.zh: 第一次跃迁到富勒烯站点时，站点没有守卫，但过一段时间后（通常约 15-20 分钟）会刷出几艘冬眠者 NPC。因此可以“忍者采集”虫洞气云站点：一直采到冬眠者出现，然后在它们发起攻击前跃迁离开。

blocks.en: A long, long time ago...
blocks.zh: 很久很久以前……

blocks.en: Ordinary Perimeter Reservoir used to be protected by 5 Sentry Towers without any spawn delay, which made this site undesirable for capsuleers attempting to "ninja harvest" the site. The sentries were replaced with Sleeper NPCs in the Catalyst major update (patch 2026-03-18.1)
blocks.zh: 普通边缘储藏库过去由 5 座岗哨塔保护，而且没有任何刷新延迟，这让想“忍者采集”的克隆飞行员对这个站点敬而远之。在催化剂大型更新（补丁 2026-03-18.1）中，这些岗哨塔被冬眠者 NPC 取代。

blocks.en: Most fullerenes are very profitable, though dangerous to harvest.
blocks.zh: 大多数富勒烯都非常赚钱，不过采集起来很危险。

blocks.en: Harvesting process
blocks.zh: 采集过程

blocks.en: Overview Settings
blocks.zh: 总览设置

blocks.en: Harvesting a gas cloud is very similar to mining an asteroid. Equip the appropriate harvesting module to a ship, locate a gas cloud, approach and target it, and activate the harvesting module. At the end of each module cycle, gas will be deposited into the cargo or mining hold. The visual effect of the harvesters is much more subdued than mining lasers, requiring you to zoom the camera very close to the ship to see.
blocks.zh: 采集气云与开采小行星非常相似。给舰船装上相应的采集装备，找到气云，接近并锁定它，然后激活采集装备。每个装备周期结束时，气体会存入货舱或矿石舱。采集器的视觉效果比采矿激光器低调得多，需要把镜头拉到离船很近才能看到。

blocks.en: Make sure you have gas clouds displayed in your overview, as they are not selectable by default. To do this, right click the overview, select open overview settings, select the filter tab, open the celestials folder, and check the Harvestable Clouds box (see screenshot right).
blocks.zh: 确保总览中显示了气云，因为默认情况下它们无法选中。设置方法：右键点击总览，选择打开总览设置，选择过滤器标签页，展开天体文件夹，勾选“可采集云团”（Harvestable Clouds）（见右侧截图）。

blocks.en: Gas can be stored in the mining/gas holds of specialized mining and hauling ships. Units of mykoserocin and cytoserocin are bulkier than individual ore units at 10 m3, while the various types of fullerite gas range from 1 to 10 m3. The range of the harvester module is much shorter than a mining laser at only 1.5 km, but the clouds are large and non-collideable.
blocks.zh: 气体可以存放在专用采矿船和运输船的矿石舱 / 气云舱中。磷胶溶质和丝胶溶质每单位 10 m3，比单个矿石单位体积更大，而各种富勒体气体每单位为 1 到 10 m3。采集装备的射程比采矿激光器短得多，只有 1.5 km，但云团很大，而且没有碰撞体积。

blocks.en: Skills
blocks.zh: 技能

blocks.en: Gas harvesting has very few skills related to it. The primary skill is Gas Cloud Harvesting, which can be bought for 30M ISK from the specialized NPC vendors, or marked up PC sell orders. This skill is trainable by alpha clones to level II. This skill requires Mining IV. You can only use one gas cloud harvester per trained skill level. Note that this is very different from normal mining, where the number of mining lasers is not determined by skills. Getting the skill to V allows for Tech 2 harvesters to be used, which have 100% increased yield over Tech 1. Gas Cloud Harvesting should be trained either to II (to equip two harvesters on a Venture or Prospect) or V (to use T2 harvesters).
blocks.zh: 与气云采集相关的技能很少。主要技能是气云采集理论，可以花 3000 万 ISK 从专门的 NPC 商人处购买，或者从加价出售的玩家卖单购买。Alpha 克隆可以把这个技能练到 II 级。该技能需要采矿技术 IV。每练一级技能只能多使用一个气云采集装备。注意这与普通采矿大不相同，普通采矿中采矿激光器的数量不受技能限制。技能练到 V 级可以使用 T2 采集装备，产量比 T1 高 100%。气云采集理论应该练到 II 级（在冲锋者级或掘金者级上装两个采集装备）或 V 级（使用 T2 采集装备）。

blocks.en: Additionally, Ventures and Prospects decrease their gas harvesting cycle duration with the Mining Frigate skill. This is the only other skill that increases gas harvesting yield, other than command bursts.
blocks.zh: 此外，冲锋者级和掘金者级的气云采集周期时间会随采矿护卫舰操作技能缩短。除了指挥脉冲波之外，这是唯一另一个能提高气云采集产量的技能。

blocks.en: General fitting and tanking skills are also recommended in order to safely fly a well fitted harvesting ship.
blocks.zh: 也推荐训练通用的装配和坦克技能，以便安全地驾驶一艘装配良好的采集船。

blocks.en: Equipment
blocks.zh: 装备

blocks.en: To get gas, you need gas cloud scoops/harvesters and a ship to put them on. There are very few real options in fitting a gas harvesting ship. Unlike regular mining, there are no modules or rigs to increase yield. There are no gas equivalents to the Mining Laser Upgrade. For each level of the Gas Cloud Harvesting skill you can fit one additional gas cloud scoop/harvester(up to a total of 5 at skill level V); all gas cloud miners have a range of 1.5 km
blocks.zh: 要采集气体，你需要气云回收装置 / 气云采集器，以及一艘能装它们的船。气云采集船的装配选择很少。与普通采矿不同，没有能提高产量的装备或改装件，也没有类似采矿激光器提升器的气云装备。气云采集理论每升一级，你就能多装一个气云回收装置 / 采集器（技能 V 级时最多 5 个）；所有气云采集装备的射程都是 1.5 km

blocks.en: Gas cloud scoops
blocks.zh: 气云回收装置

blocks.en: Gas cloud scoops are placed in the high slots and require a turret hardpoint each. These modules are intended to be used with Mining frigates, but can be fit to any ship that has a turret hardpoint.
blocks.zh: 气云回收装置安装在高槽，每个需要占用一个炮台安装点。这类装备是为采矿护卫舰设计的，但任何有炮台安装点的船都能装。

en: Click on the column headers to sort the table; mouse over them for a more detailed explanation. More information: Skills - Tech and Meta levels.
zh: 点击列标题可对表格排序；鼠标悬停在列标题上可查看更详细的说明。更多信息：技能 - 科技与衍生等级。

blocks.en: Gas cloud harvesters
blocks.zh: 气云采集器

blocks.en: Gas cloud harvesters are placed in the high slots. These modules are restricted to be used with Mining Barges and Exhumers. Harvesters mine a larger amount but with a longer cycle time.
blocks.zh: 气云采集器安装在高槽。这类装备仅限采矿驳船和采掘者使用。采集器每次采集量更大，但周期时间更长。

en: Click on the column headers to sort the table; mouse over them for a more detailed explanation. More information: Skills - Tech and Meta levels.
zh: 点击列标题可对表格排序；鼠标悬停在列标题上可查看更详细的说明。更多信息：技能 - 科技与衍生等级。

blocks.en: Ships
blocks.zh: 舰船

blocks.en: With the arrival of the Catalyst expansion, options have expanded in regards to gas harvesting.
blocks.zh: 随着催化剂资料片的到来，气云采集的选择变多了。

blocks.en: While gas cloud scoops can be mounted on any ship with turret slots, gas is very voluminous and should only be harvested using ships supporting a mining hold to carry any meaningful amount of gas. The entry-level ship, but also the most widely used ship, for gas harvesting is the Venture, which has a decent mining hold and a bonus to gas cloud scoop yield.
blocks.zh: 虽然任何有炮台槽位的船都能装气云回收装置，但气体体积非常大，只有带矿石舱的船才能装下有意义的量，所以应该只用这类船来采集。气云采集的入门船，同时也是使用最广泛的船，是冲锋者级，它有不错的矿石舱，还有气云回收装置产量加成。

blocks.en: The Pioneer, while having an additional turret slot, has a reduced bonus to yield, which results in a nearly identical harvest rate per second as a venture, while being less maneuverable. It, however, boasts a larger mining hold, as well as more tank and drone bandwidth to defend itself.
blocks.zh: 开拓者级虽然多一个炮台槽位，但产量加成较低，结果每秒采集速度与冲锋者级几乎相同，机动性却更差。不过它的矿石舱更大，坦度和无人机带宽也更高，便于自卫。

blocks.en: The faction ships, Venture Consortium Issue and Pioneer Consortium Issue, have no additional bonus to gas harvesting, and only have a slightly increased mining hold and stronger combat capabilities when compared to their tech I variants. Due to the significant additional cost of the hulls, they are seldom used for this activity.
blocks.zh: 势力舰船冲锋者级财团型和开拓者级财团型没有额外的气云采集加成，与 T1 版本相比只是矿石舱略大、战斗能力更强。由于船体价格高出很多，很少有人用它们来采气。

blocks.en: The Prospect is the second most popular choice for gas harvesting. While having the same bonuses as the Venture, it is more maneuverable, tankier, has more slots for utility and, most importantly, has the ability to fit a Covert Ops Cloaking Device, giving it more safety in the hostile environments in which the more valuable forms of gas are found. In addition, it has a significantly larger mining hold for the gas, and a larger regular cargo hold allowing for a mobile depot to be carried. However, it is substantially more expensive than the Venture and gives up the integrated warp core stability. These two factors combines with the dangerous locations where gas clouds are found explain the general preference for the Venture.
blocks.zh: 掘金者级是气云采集的第二热门选择。它拥有与冲锋者级相同的加成，但机动性更强、坦度更高、功能槽位更多，最重要的是能装配隐秘行动隐形装置，在发现更值钱气体的危险环境中更安全。此外，它的矿石舱大得多，普通货舱也更大，可以携带移动式仓库。不过它比冲锋者级贵得多，而且没有内置的跃迁核心稳定。这两个因素，再加上气云所在位置的危险性，解释了为什么大家普遍更喜欢冲锋者级。

blocks.en: In addition to mining frigates and destroyers, all Mining Barges and Exhumers have bonuses to gas harvesting. However, their low mobility makes them a risky choice. For this reason, they are usually only used in fleets where proper defensive capabilities are in place. Their attributes and bonuses in regards to gas harvesting are in line with their bonuses for mining:
blocks.zh: 除了采矿护卫舰和驱逐舰，所有采矿驳船和采掘者都有气云采集加成。不过它们机动性差，选用它们风险较大。因此，它们通常只在有完善防御的舰队中使用。它们在气云采集方面的属性和加成与采矿方面一致：

en: Covetor/Hulk : Highest yield, low tank, small mining hold
Retriever/Mackinaw : Medium yield, medium tank, largest mining hold
Procurer/Skiff : Low yield, highest tank, medium mining hold, +drone damage
zh: 妄想级/霍克级：产量最高，坦度低，矿石舱小
回旋者级/麦基诺级：产量中等，坦度中等，矿石舱最大
猎获级/轻舟级：产量低，坦度最高，矿石舱中等，+无人机伤害

blocks.en: As a support to gas harvesting, the Industrial Command Ships, the Porpoise and the Orca, can be used to apply boosts and provide compression to huffing fleets. The usage of these ships is in line with the usage of mining barges, and is strongly discouraged if not part of a properly defended fleet.
blocks.zh: 作为气云采集的支援，工业指挥舰海豚级和逆戟鲸级可以为吸气舰队提供加成和压缩。这些船的用法与采矿驳船一致，如果不是在防御完善的舰队中，强烈不建议使用。

blocks.en: Finally, in order to provide boosts to smaller gas huffing fleets, Command Destroyers are a very popular choice. In particular, the Outrider, introduced by the Catalyst expansion, is a perfect fit for this role, as it has a very decent mining hold to carry harvested gas and, as such, can also fit gas cloud scoops.
blocks.zh: 最后，为了给规模较小的吸气舰队提供加成，指挥驱逐舰是非常受欢迎的选择。特别是催化剂资料片推出的先驱级，非常适合这个角色，因为它有相当不错的矿石舱来装采到的气体，因此也能装气云回收装置。

blocks.en: Boosts
blocks.zh: 加成

blocks.en: Main article: Command Bursts
blocks.zh: 主条目：指挥脉冲波

blocks.en: While some buffs apply differently to gas harvesting than mining, there are two Mining Foreman Bursts that are very effective when fielding a command ship or command destroyer: Mining Laser Optimization and Mining Laser Efficiency. The mining laser optimization will fully apply, reducing the cycle time (and as such increasing yield) of harvesting modules, and the mining laser efficiency, while having no effect on critical chance since gas cloud scoops and gas cloud harvesters cannot apply critical hits, will nonetheless reduce residue, increasing the total yield per cloud.
blocks.zh: 虽然有些增益对气云采集的作用方式与采矿不同，但在使用指挥舰或指挥驱逐舰时，有两种开采先锋脉冲波非常有效：采矿激光器优化和采矿激光器效率。采矿激光器优化会完全生效，缩短采集装备的周期时间（从而提高产量）；而采矿激光器效率虽然对暴击几率没有作用（气云回收装置和气云采集器不会触发暴击），但仍能减少残渣，提高每团气云的总产量。

blocks.en: Implants
blocks.zh: 植入体

blocks.en: Main article: Skill Hardwiring
blocks.zh: 主条目：技能硬连线

blocks.en: The Eifyr and Co. 'Alchemist' Gas Harvesting is the only implant range which affects gas harvesting. It reduces gas harvester cycle time, and is available in 1%, 3%, and 5% varieties. They are sold in most industry-oriented NPC corporation LP stores.
blocks.zh: 埃菲尔公司 炼金术士 气云采集是唯一影响气云采集的植入体系列。它能缩短气云采集器的周期时间，有 1%、3% 和 5% 三种。大多数以工业为主的 NPC 军团 LP 商店都有出售。

blocks.en: Gas value
blocks.zh: 气云价值

blocks.en: Gas does not have to be refined in order to use it, as ore and ice products do. It can be used directly in various Reactions. The difference in value between gasses can be extreme, due to the scarcity of the gas and the value of the end products. While C320/540 is highly valuable, the risk versus reward is often too high for beginners. Many find that a more manageable target is to harvest C50 as the risk is low and the reward is decent. Harvesting C320/540 will normally require several people working together, which usually means using haulers and a dedicated scout.
blocks.zh: 气体不像矿石和冰矿产品那样需要提炼才能使用。它可以直接用于各种反应。由于气体的稀缺程度和最终产品价值不同，不同气体之间的价值差异可能非常悬殊。C320/540 虽然价值很高，但对新手来说风险往往远大于回报。许多人认为采集 C50 是更容易上手的目标，风险低，回报也不错。采集 C320/540 通常需要几个人合作，这一般意味着要用到运输船和专职侦察兵。
